value.rationale: The result is a natural complete classification on a canonical distance-transitive graph family, not an arbitrary finite slice. It resolves every cardinality of geodetic sets and every inclusion-minimal geodetic set, exposes the exact role of the deleted matching, and yields \(g^+(\operatorname{Cr}_n)=n\) and the closed minimal-set count \(n+2+20\binom{n}{6}\). These facts are not implied by the known scalar minimum.
